text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит loses to Нарита Таисин
and cries in
frustration at her defeat.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Taishin, though reluctant to admit it,
seems to
have gained a new respect for
Ticket's
wholehearted efforts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит begins training once
again, in
order to win against her rivals
at the Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
